audit_item: F7 fixed-memory exact VaR/CVaR tail selection
finding: The online return reducer held an exact lower-tail heap proportional to the configured tail count.
change: Cap the online heap at 8192 values. For larger configured tails, spool float64 returns to an automatically deleted temporary file and use in-place NumPy memmap partition for exact VaR plus fsum of the selected slice for CVaR.
scope: RouteB .venv-win-app; synthetic returns only. tracemalloc reports Python allocations and does not measure process RSS or a full historical Train workload. No market, account, Validation, Test, or Holdout data was accessed.
